subject: CareBridge go-live preflight: streaming + tool call + JSON acceptance
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@carebridgehealth.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2029-12-01T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: CareBridge go-live preflight: streaming + tool call + JSON acceptance

Hi Jasmine / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We are on track for a target production cutover on 2029-12-12 but want to run a short preflight to lock the shape of streaming events, the tool-calling contract, and the JSON output schema. Our implementation team has three non-negotiable items before we sign off:

1) A stable streaming message schema that includes the new event types (clinical_note_delta, encounter_update).
2) Tool-call examples for the two external actions we will allow (lookup_med_history, schedule_followup).
3) A mutual action plan that lists owners, dates, and acceptance criteria (we need this by EOD 2029-12-05).

I attached a draft mutual action plan (basic timeline) — can Redwood confirm owners and whether the streaming_schema_v1.json we discussed will be the final artifact or a living doc? Also looping in procurement (procurement@carebridgehealth.com) for contract/PO timing.

If you can confirm the owner for the JSON acceptance (schema sign-off) and whether Redwood can provide a small contract amendment for the tool-call feature, we can lock the go/no-go for 12/12.

Appreciate a concise checklist and expected delivery times.

Best,
Sara Patel
Director, Engineering
CareBridge Health

Attachments: 2029-12-01_CBH_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@carebridgehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-12-02T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CareBridge go-live preflight: streaming + tool call + JSON acceptance

Sara — thanks for laying this out clearly. Short answer: we can meet your preflight asks. Below is a concise mutual action plan and owners we can commit to this week.

Mutual action items (high level) — target sign-offs by 2029-12-05:
- Streaming schema (streaming_schema_v1.json): Owner: Monica Patel (Redwood). Deliverable: canonical JSON schema + example payloads.
- Tool-call contract & samples (toolcall_examples.md): Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood). Deliverable: examples + security checklist (auth scopes, rate limits).
- Schema acceptance testing: Owner: Aaron Li (CareBridge) + Redwood test harness (Rishi). Deliverable: 5 sample events and pass/fail checklist.
- Contract amendment (tool-call addendum): Owner: Redwood Legal (Marissa to coordinate) + procurement@carebridgehealth.com. Deliverable: 1‑page amendment PDF for signature.

Requested dates and delivery:
- 12/03: Redwood provides streaming_schema_v1.json and toolcall_examples.md (draft).
- 12/04: CareBridge runs sample tests; sends back any blocker items.
- 12/05 EOD: Final sign-off or explicit list of remaining blockers.

We are attaching the streaming_schema_v1.json (draft) and toolcall_examples.md to this thread. Monica will own schema updates; Rishi will provide the small test harness (curl + sample payloads) for you to run locally. If procurement needs a PDF amendment by 12/04 morning we will prioritize.

Questions for you: do you need the schema in a different format (OpenAPI component) or is the JSON Schema file sufficient? Also, what is the preferred verification environment (staging endpoint URL or local mock)?

Thanks — we will keep the notes tight and action-oriented so procurement can sign off quickly.

— Jasmine Liu
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

Attachments: streaming_schema_v1.json (draft schema), toolcall_examples.md (examples & auth notes)
From: Aaron Li <aaron.li@carebridgehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara@carebridgehealth.com>, procurement@carebridgehealth.com
Date: 2029-12-03T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CareBridge go-live preflight: streaming + tool call + JSON acceptance

Jasmine / team — quick confirmation from engineering side after reviewing the drafts.

- streaming_schema_v1.json: structure looks good; we have two suggested clarifications (listed inline in the schema file): 1) add optional metadata.event_source string, 2) loosen timestamp format to accept RFC3339 or epoch_millis. Neither are blockers for the 12/12 cutover but we would like them by final sign-off.
- toolcall_examples.md: good. Please add an explicit example that shows an unauthorized-tool-call response (401 + body) so our QA can validate error handling.
- Mutual action plan: procurement needs the amendment PDF by 12/04 09:00 PST to issue PO internally. Sara — can you confirm procurement will push if amendment arrives by then?

We can own the schema acceptance testing and will run the Redwood-provided test harness on 12/04. If all pass we will provide sign-off email on 12/05.

On Sun, Dec 1, 2029 at 14:02 Sara Patel <sara@carebridgehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call this morning. > 2) Tool-call examples for the two external actions we will allow (lookup_med_history, schedule_followup).
> 3) A mutual action plan that lists owners, dates, and acceptance criteria (we need this by EOD 2029-12-05).

Thanks,
Aaron

Attachments referenced: inline comments on streaming_schema_v1.json
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@carebridgehealth.com>, Aaron Li <aaron.li@carebridgehealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement@carebridgehealth.com
Date: 2029-12-05T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Final: CareBridge preflight artifacts and next steps (schema sign-off window)

Hi Sara / Aaron — following up with the final artifacts for your preflight window. Per our committed timeline: 

Delivered today (attachments + links):
- streaming_schema_v1.json (final draft) — we incorporated the optional metadata.event_source string and accept RFC3339/epoch_millis for timestamps.
- toolcall_examples.md — added unauthorized example and a short auth appendix (scopes & token rotation cadence).
- 2029-12-01_CBH_mutual_action_plan.xlsx — updated owners and added the legal amendment deliverable (Marissa -> Legal).

Next steps:
- CareBridge runs the Redwood test harness (Rishi) and returns pass/fail by EOD 2029-12-05. If pass, Redwood will produce the amendment PDF for procurement by 2029-12-06 morning.
- If any blockers are found, please file a short ticket in the Jira link below with priority=blocker and we will triage immediately.

Jira: https://redwood-inference.atlassian.net/browse/CBH-145
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=schemalink-STREAM-V1

We will be standing by to do a quick sync (15 min) if you prefer to walk through the failing cases instead of a ticket. Looking forward to sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
